newsitem.title: HUNGARY: GERMANY BAYERNWERK SETS UP NEW HUNGARY SUBSIDIARY.
newsitem.headline: GERMANY BAYERNWERK SETS UP NEW HUNGARY SUBSIDIARY.

text.p: BUDAPEST, July 11 (Platt's) - Germany's Bayernwerk set up a new holding company called Bayernwerk Hungaria Energie AG for its electricity and gas distribution operations in Hungary, the company said on Friday.
Konrad Kreuzer, up to now director of Bayernwerk's legal department, has been named chairman of the management board of the new group.
Since late 1995 Bayernwerk has acquired ownership shares on three electric distribution groups and one gas distributor which have total sales of about $900 million and serve 2.5 million customers.
This has made Bayermwerk Hungaria the largest gas and energy distributor in the country, the company said.
Bayernwerk bought a 25 percent stake in gas distributor KOGAZ in 1995 and then took a 47.25 percent stake in another utility DEDASZ later the same year.
